mandatories.value: The product name **Meltemi Fizz** is always written in Latin script, in full. Never transliterated, never abbreviated to "Fizz".
mandatories.anchor: is always written in Latin script, in full

mandatories.value: Logo clear space: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides.
mandatories.anchor: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides

mandatories.value: Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518.
mandatories.anchor: Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518

mandatories.value: Backgrounds must not use gradients over photography.
mandatories.anchor: Backgrounds must not use gradients over photography

mandatories.value: Permitted: "zero sugar", "φυσικά συστατικά" (per approved ingredient list).
mandatories.anchor: Permitted: "zero sugar", "φυσικά συστατικά" (per approved ingredient list)

mandatories.value: Not permitted: any health or weight-loss claim.
Not permitted: any comparison naming a competitor brand.
mandatories.anchor: any comparison naming a competitor brand

mandatories.value: No alcohol association of any kind (imagery, occasions, co-branding).
mandatories.anchor: No alcohol association of any kind (imagery, occasions, co-branding)

mandatories.value: Avoid generic "beach party" clichés; the brand leans premium-everyday, not spring break.
Confident, modern Greek with natural use of English category terms.
mandatories.anchor: Confident, modern Greek with natural use of English category terms

mandatories.value: Humor allowed; sarcasm about competitors is not.
mandatories.anchor: Humor allowed; sarcasm about competitors is not

open_questions.gap: The guidelines phrase the "beach party" point as "avoid" under Category no-gos, so it is unclear whether it is a hard prohibition or a stylistic preference.
open_questions.why_it_matters: A hard no-go must be checked in every creative round, while a preference can be traded off.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Το «beach party» ως κλισέ είναι απαράβατος κανόνας για το brand ή προτίμηση που μπορεί να έχει εξαιρέσεις;

open_questions.gap: The tone lines sit under a section labelled "guidance"; it is unclear whether the tone of voice and the rule on sarcasm are binding for this project.
open_questions.why_it_matters: It determines whether copy that departs from this tone is rejected or only commented on.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Οι οδηγίες για το ύφος (και ο κανόνας για τον σαρκασμό απέναντι στους ανταγωνιστές) είναι δεσμευτικές για αυτό το project ή καθοδηγητικές;
